source_text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid. The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb. The box should be safe to use, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
product_intent: A small storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until manually released by a user's thumb

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb
The box should be safe to use

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until manually released by a user's thumb

verification.observable: The lid remains closed when not manually released by a thumb and opens when manually released by a thumb
verification.condition: User applies thumb pressure to the lid to release it

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe to use

verification.observable: No sharp edges, hazardous materials or components that could cause injury during normal use

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble

verification.observable: Assembly can be completed with minimal tools and time by a typical user
verification.condition: User attempts to assemble the product following standard instructions

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture

verification.observable: Product can be manufactured using standard production methods without excessive complexity or cost

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a desktop-sized form factor

verification.observable: Product dimensions must fit within desktop space constraints
verification.condition: Product is measured against standard desktop workspace requirements

requirements.statement: The storage box must operate manually only

verification.observable: Product operates without any electrical or mechanical power source

requirements.statement: The storage box must be designed for additive manufacturing

verification.observable: Product design is compatible with additive manufacturing processes
verification.condition: Design review against additive manufacturing capabilities

operating_scenarios.name: Normal Operation
operating_scenarios.description: A user places items in the storage box and closes the lid manually, then releases it with thumb pressure to access contents

operating_scenarios.name: Assembly Process
operating_scenarios.description: A user attempts to assemble the storage box from its components using standard assembly procedures
